newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador money base up to 2.73 bln sucres on Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador money base up to 2.73 bln sucres on Oct 4.

text.p: Ecuador's money base rose 6.6 percent to 2.73 billion sucres in the week to October 4, the Central Bank said Monday.
In the month of September the money base grew 0.87 percent to 2.56 billion sucres.
The bank gave no explanation for the latest increase.
The money base grew 15.12 percent between January and October 4.
The money base ended 1995 at 2.41 billion sucres, up from 1.85 billion at the end of 1994.
